description: This Java class 'ValueLinkApi' implements encryption, decryption, key management, and communication with the ValueLink third-party payment system, including cryptographic operations, key generation, and request/response handling.

classes.name: ValueLinkApi
classes.description: Main class providing cryptographic operations, key management, and communication with ValueLink payment system.

methods.name: encryptPin
methods.description: Encrypts a PIN using configured cryptographic keys and returns a hex string for transmission.

methods.name: decryptPin
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted PIN hex string back to plain text.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a request map to the configured ValueLink URL and returns the response map.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of ValueLinkApi, optionally reloading configuration.

methods.name: outputKeyCreation
methods.description: Outputs cryptographic key creation details for manual database updates.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Creates a public/private key pair based on ValueLink parameters.

methods.name: generateKek
methods.description: Generates a Key Encryption Key (KEK) for secure key exchange.

methods.name: getValueLinkPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key object for ValueLink's public key.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key object for the merchant.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates a new Merchant Working Key (MWK).

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates an MWK from a given DES key byte array.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Generates an MWK from a pre-generated DESede SecretKey.

methods.name: encryptViaKek
methods.description: Encrypts data using the KEK.

methods.name: decryptViaKek
methods.description: Decrypts data using the KEK.

methods.name: getDateString
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as per ValueLink requirements.

methods.name: getWorkingKeyIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the current working key index.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a ValueLink-compatible string.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a ValueLink amount string into a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code, currently fixed to '840'.

methods.name: getInitialRequestMap
methods.description: Creates initial request parameters for ValueLink transactions.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Retrieves cached database record for merchant keys.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads cryptographic keys into cache.

methods.name: getDHParameterSpec
methods.description: Creates DH parameter spec from configured prime and generator.

methods.name: cryptoViaKek
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption using KEK with IV handling.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Cipher instance for DESede with IV.

methods.name: getPinCheckSum
methods.description: Calculates a simple checksum byte for a PIN.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates a byte array of random bytes.

methods.name: getMwkKey
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs the MWK SecretKey.

methods.name: getKekKey
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs the KEK SecretKey.

methods.name: getDesEdeKey
methods.description: Creates a SecretKey object from raw byte array.

methods.name: getMwk
methods.description: Retrieves the MWK byte array from database record.

methods.name: getKek
methods.description: Retrieves the KEK byte array from database record.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyBytes
methods.description: Retrieves private key bytes from database record.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses HTML response string into a map of response data.

methods.name: parseHistoryResponse
methods.description: Parses HTML table of history data into list of maps.

methods.name: getByteRange
methods.description: Extracts a subarray of bytes from a given byte array.

methods.name: copyBytes
methods.description: Copies source byte array into target at specified position.
